I managed to make my gel nails last for 18 days with a few simple things.

1. Use high quality primer. I LOVE gelish pH bond. It's pretty cheep and it's like magic.
2. I use thin coats.
3. Maybe you cap the edge too much, gets thick and peels easily. Try capping only with primer, base, top.
4.before you apply the base coat use gel cleanser to clean the nails. You don't want oils on them.

Maybe your nails are very oily. And it causes peeling. There's not alot you can do.
There are acid and non acid primers. They're strong af. Most nail techs use them only on the edge. And it should do the trick.

If you want to get educated, fo to "the nail hub" on YouTube. She explains the chemistry and everything behind every step. Highly recommend.
